# Google AI Plus Portal

> An independent, open-source Windows desktop utility that automates 12-month Google AI Plus promotional onboarding and resolves your direct Google One offer link 100% locally.

Google AI Plus Portal runs entirely on your Windows 10 or Windows 11 PC with zero telemetry, zero remote servers, and no bundled browser bloat. It attaches to your existing Chromium browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, or Vivaldi), pauses cleanly whenever a human confirmation step or security check appears, and saves your resolved offer link locally.

## Canonical Resources

- [Web Portal](https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/): Interactive landing page featuring a read-only desktop app preview, 3D scroll-driven workflow, interactive feature spotlight, and topic-filtered FAQ.
- [Full Documentation](https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Single-file technical and user guide covering desktop architecture, workflow stages, FAQ, and privacy disclosures.
- [Desktop App Repository](https://github.com/nmrisrl11/gemini-ai-plus-portal): Open-source Windows desktop utility source code and build workflows.
- [Latest Windows Release](https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/download): Pre-built standalone Windows download (redirects to the latest release build; mirrored on GitHub Releases with published checksums and VirusTotal scan reports).
- [Web Portal Repository](https://github.com/nmrisrl11/gemini-ai-plus-app): Open-source React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 8 landing page source code.

## Web Portal Sections

- [Interactive Desktop Preview](https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/#preview): Read-only browser simulation of the Windows desktop utility using RFC 2606 `@example.com` sample data, paired with a Google AI Plus plan benefits summary.
- [How It Works](https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/#how-it-works): Four-step local workflow (Setup, Browser, Confirm, Ready) presented on a lazy-loaded Three.js scroll rail.
- [Features](https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/#features): Interactive split-spotlight covering zero-bloat browser reuse, local-only privacy, single-file Windows launch, and safe pause & recovery.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/#faq): Topic-filtered answers covering Privacy, Setup, and Billing.
- [Download](https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/#download): Direct link to the latest public GitHub release for Windows 10 and Windows 11.

## Privacy & Non-Affiliation

- **100% Local Execution**: Runs strictly on the user's Windows PC with no accounts, analytics, or external relays.
- **Independent Open-Source Utility**: Licensed under the MIT License and not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Google LLC, Alphabet Inc., or Internshala.
